title: Pairs of Songs With Total Durations Divisible by 60
goal: Count pairs of distinct songs whose total duration is divisible by sixty.
strategy: A remainder r needs (60-r) modulo 60. Count earlier partners before adding the current song, including the special zero and thirty buckets.

phasePurposes.start: Count pairs of distinct songs whose total duration is divisible by sixty.

phasePurposes.done: Count pairs of distinct songs whose total duration is divisible by sixty.

edgeCases: Zero remainders pair with earlier zeros
Thirty remainders pair with each other
One song cannot pair with itself
